composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. creative_direction: Frame a terraced blue-green mineral so its tiny steps resemble a calm canyon descending from the left.
